The rule is docs/principles/domain-scoped-dependencies.md.
Four classes, and the class is the whole rule. scripts/gates/_census.py
is the classifier both domain gates share.
substrate — always on. Anything may depend on it. It may depend on
nothing but other substrate. Switching it off is not a
feature request, it is a different product.
plumbing  — the engine's connective tissue (state, error, plugin
registry, wire types). Every engine module imports it, so
it cannot be shell; nobody switches it off, so it is not a
block. It is held to substrate's rule: anything may depend
on it, it may depend only on substrate and plumbing.
block     — removable. It may depend on substrate and on its own
domain. It may NOT depend on another domain's block: that
is what makes two features fail together.
shell     — the composition root. It exists to know every block, so it
is exempt. Keeping the exempt set small is the point; a
shell that grows logic has stopped being a composition root.
Unlisted defaults to a block whose domain is its own name: a crate, a
command module, or a ui/src directory or bare file. The two exceptions
are stated where they apply: a module beside engine commands/ has no
default, and a file inside a listed ui/src directory is that directory's.
Substrate and plumbing may not SPELL a block's name either: that is the
names half of the rule, checked by scripts/gates/domain_names.py over
scripts/domain-names.json.
`allowed` is a GRANDFATHER LIST, not a design. Every entry is a violation
that predates the gate, kept so the gate could land green rather than
block unrelated work. Entries come off as the code is touched; nothing is
added without an issue number saying why the edge cannot be removed.
crates/cubical-engine/src/commands/*. A module not listed is a block
whose domain is its own name, so a new command is fenced in until the
census says otherwise.
crates/cubical-engine/src/* modules outside commands/, each checked
as a source and as a target. There is no default: an unlisted module
fails the gate, because skipping it is how plugins and state hid their
edges while this comment called them shell. A module that belongs to
one domain takes that domain, so a block's handle moved beside
commands/, or substrate such as the watcher living in events.rs, stays
visible. compose and lib are the shell: compose assembles one vault's
blocks and lib only declares modules.

_: A directory under ui/src is a domain; a bare file under ui/src is its
own domain named after the file. A key with a slash is a path prefix
inside a directory and the longest match wins: that is how the editor
directory holds the always-on editor core and each preview feature as
separate domains. A file no prefix claims takes its directory's entry,
so a new file in editor/ or api/ is substrate until given a prefix; a
directory or bare file the census does not name at all defaults to
block, so a new feature directory is fenced in from its first commit.
An api/ wrapper takes the class of the engine command it calls: one
wire contract, one class.
